metadata.description: Brief description of the incident. What happened, to whom, and what was the impact?

path.description: Step 1: Describe the initial access vector. What generic vulnerability was exploited? For Social Engineering (#9), the vulnerability is human psychological susceptibility.

dre.title: Credentials Harvested
dre.desc: Describe what data was exposed or compromised.

path.evidence: Cite your source: CVE advisories, vendor reports, news articles, internal IR findings.

path.description: Step 2: Credential use is ALWAYS #4 Identity Theft (R-CRED), regardless of how the credentials were acquired.
Step 3: If Foreign Executable Content runs, record a #7 Malware step with R-EXEC. The FEC moment is when the payload actually executes, not when it arrives.
Step 4: Final impact. Abuse of Functionality (#1) when the attacker uses legitimate system features for unintended purposes (e.g., data exfiltration via allowed APIs).

dre.title: Data Exfiltration and Service Disruption
dre.desc: Describe the data risk events. C=Confidentiality, I=Integrity, A=Availability, Ac=Accessibility.

bizRisk.title: Business Impact Category
bizRisk.desc: Describe operational, financial, reputational, or regulatory impact.
